faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AFT Jabalpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AFT Jabalpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, 1 Junior Accounts Officer, 1 Junior Accountant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AFT Jabalpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma) attached to the circular) and send it to Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Jabalpur, 106 Bhagat Marg, Old Chief Engineer Office, Near Sadar Bazar, Jabalpur Cantt-482001, by through the parent department by the competent authority, to reach by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Matrix Level 7 (Rs 44900-142400) for Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs 35400-112400) for Junior Accounts Officer, Pay Matrix Level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) for Junior Accountant.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tribunal Officer/Section Officer: Degree of a recognized University with 2 years experience in personnel, administrative or judicial work. Junior Accounts Officer: training in cash and accounts work from ISTM or an equivalent course and 2 years experience of cash, accounts and budget work. Junior Accountant: Bachelor's degree from a recognized University. Each post also needs the specified analogous post or feeder-grade service. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Junior Accounts Officer and Junior Accountant: open to Central Government employees only. Applicant must be an eligible officer who can be spared if selected.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder grade who are in direct line of promotion. Applications without supporting documents, photographs, unsigned or incomplete in any manner are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation basis for a period of three years. Deputation period including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall not ordinarily exceed 3 years. A deputationist in the Armed Forces Tribunal shall not be eligible for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Jabalpur.
